                                 WALK-IN-INTERVIEW

Applications are invited from eligible candidates to appear for a walk-in-interview for
the engagement of Guest Faculty in the Department of Bengali, Political Science and
Education on a purely temporary basis.

INTERVIEW DETAILS:
Date:   08/08/2026
Time:          12.00 Noon
Venue:         Chamber of the Principal, Radhamadhab College, Silchar-06
Eligibility: Candidates must possess the qualifications as prescribed by the UGC and
             the Government of Assam from time to time.


CANDIDATES ARE REQUESTED TO BRING:

    Updated Bio-Data/Curriculum Vitae (CV).
    Original Certificates of and Marksheets from HSLC onwards.
    One set of Self Attested photocopies of all testimonials.
    Two recent passport-size photographs.

NOTE:-

    No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the interview.
    The College reserves the right to cancel or modify the interview process without
         assigning any reason.
